result.summary: The plan safely covers semantic node-registry convergence across both sync phases, fail-closed conflict boundaries, concurrency tests, and affected intent documentation.

checklist.description: Add a cohesive node-registry merge module beside the existing Goal merge that parses base, local, and remote snapshots through NodeRegistry, requires unique nonempty canonical node identities and comparable update timestamps, retains the union of records, preserves one-sided changes, chooses the later version of a concurrently changed record, and declines ambiguous ties or invalid input.

Extend the existing semantic reconciliation boundary to prepare nodes.json and Goal results before generic conflict detection in both the initial pass and rejected-push retry, then carry all prepared paths through the established commit, live hydration, concurrent-write preservation, and baseline flow.

Keep automatic resolution atomic and narrow by never inferring node deletion from an absent record, withholding every prepared merge when any unrelated path remains unresolved, and retaining complete conflict reporting for malformed registries, duplicate identities, timestamp ambiguity, or genuine shared-state divergence.

Add focused unit and multi-node synchronization regressions covering disjoint heartbeat updates, record union, one-sided record changes, later-timestamp selection, equal-timestamp disagreement, malformed or duplicate registries, mixed unresolved paths, and remote advancement during a rejected push.

Update the Target App and Fleet intent pages in their existing format to define nodes.json as semantically merged shared state whose heartbeat-only churn does not stale-fence sync health or downgrade fleet-count authority while ambiguous or genuine conflicts still fail closed.

result.summary: Make nodes.json a semantically reconciled per-node registry during ordinary Git state synchronization so independent heartbeat updates converge across active nodes while invalid or ambiguous registry changes and genuine shared-state conflicts remain fenced.

checklist.evidence: Added src/tools/host/git_sync/node_registry_merge.rs. It parses all three snapshots through NodeRegistry, validates unique nonempty lowercase canonical IDs and RFC3339 updated_at values, preserves raw unknown fields, retains the sorted union, keeps one-sided records, applies per-record later-timestamp selection, and rejects equal-time disagreement or invalid input.

Generalized prepare_semantic_state_changes and write_reconciled_state_changes so nodes.json and Goal merges are prepared before generic conflicts in initial sync and push retry. The same semantic preparation is used by reported-recovery preview/apply comparison, and resolved paths continue through existing commit, live hydration, concurrent-write preservation, and baseline publication.

Record absence preserves the observed/base record instead of deleting it. Prepared node merges are excluded only from their own path conflict and are not written until all unrelated paths pass conflict detection; malformed registries, duplicate/noncanonical IDs, invalid timestamps, and equal-time disagreements return None and remain complete ordinary conflicts.

Added seven merge-policy unit tests plus multi-clone tests for disjoint heartbeat convergence, atomic withholding with an unrelated shared-state conflict, and rejected-push remote advancement. Coverage includes union, one-sided updates, non-deletion, later timestamps, equal-time ambiguity, malformed/duplicate/noncanonical/uncomparable registries, unknown-field retention, and retry convergence.

Updated docs/intent/02-foundation/03-target-app.md and 04-fleet.md in their established format to define per-node semantic registry merging, heartbeat-only convergence without stale fencing/count downgrade, and fail-closed ambiguity/unrelated-conflict behavior.
